name: visual
description: CLI walls-of-text → interactive HTML dark-theme views. The page carries the EVIDENCE, not the account of it: real artifact embedded, raw output verbatim, provenance for every number — enforced by a pre-ExitPlanMode gate. Prose is REFUSED by the builder: every text field is checked (≤140 chars per bullet, one sentence each, no continuation connective, max 6 per block) and a violation aborts without writing the page. Each problem's body is born folded — the title stays visible, consequence and proposal open on click under a label derived from the content itself. Plans, diagnostics and decisions in the browser with live sync back to Claude.
